# Responder

`responder` &middot; _sniffing-spoofing_

Answers broadcast name-resolution requests to reveal credentials on a Windows network.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- A network segment you own or are contracted to assess.
- Root, and a bridged network (WSL2 NAT limits what it can see).
- Explicit authorisation: Responder captures credentials.

## How to use it

Responder poisons LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS so clients send you their hashes. Only ever run it on an authorised internal assessment; it is disruptive.

## Examples

```console
$ responder -I eth0 -wrf
```
